definition: quarrelling with petulant or peevish arguments; bickering; verbal contention.
example: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ವಾಕ್ಕಲಹ ಆರಂಭವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A petty matter started a bout of bickering between the two of them.

definition: the vernacular language of a region or country; a dialect.
example: ಈ ಹಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಮ್ಮ ಊರಿನ ದೇಸೆ ಸೊಗಸಾಗಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Our region's dialect has been used beautifully in this song.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear; to be distressed by the emotion of fear.
example_en: Hearing the news of the earthquake, all the people became fearful.

definition: a man with good behaviour.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಸಜ್ಜನ ಆರ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone praised him as a man of good behaviour.

definition: the act of seeing or being seen.
example: ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯ ದರಿಸಿನ ಪಡೆದು ಮನಸ್ಸು ಶಾಂತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The mind became peaceful after having a sight of the idol in the temple.

definition: the plant Dioscorea alata of Dioscoreaceae family.
example_en: The vine of the winged yam spread over the fence.

definition: ruled; reigned; governed.
example: ಈ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷ ಅವನಿಂದ ಶಾಸಿತವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: This kingdom was ruled by him for many years.

definition: absence of heat or lack of normal warmth; a low temperature; coldness.
example_en: The coldness on the hilltop hit the body.

definition: one who is in charge of or who has the responsibility of, supervision.
example_en: He himself is the one in charge of supervising this construction work.

definition: carrying a load; drafting.
example_en: The drafting oxen were pulling the cart.

definition: the Vulpes bengalensis, a wild canine with bushy tail and, commonly, grey fur, which is conventionally thought of as sly and crafty.
example_en: The fox prowled around the field's edge at night.

definition: to trust; to have confidence; to depend on.
example_en: I trust your word.

definition: the total produce of a leased agricultural holding, including the owner's share in it.
example_en: The tenant got his share of the total produce.

definition: the diver bird, water crow.
example_en: The diver bird swam in the pond and caught fish.

definition: a man fit to have a compact, covenant with.
example_en: He was a person fit to make a covenant with.

definition: to insert an inset in; to set a jewel ornamental piece, etc. into a surface as to make design, to decorate, etc.; to inlay.
example_en: The goldsmith inlaid a gem into the gold ornament.

definition: the cardinal number four.
example_en: Four children were playing in the courtyard.

definition: a feast arranged during harvesting season.
example_en: Every year a harvest feast is held in the village.

definition: to strike with a blow with the hand or fist; to box; to punch.
example_en: In anger, he punched his enemy with his fist.

definition: an undomesticated sheep.
example_en: A wild sheep in the forest got scared and ran away.

definition: (milk) to become curds; to coagulate.
example_en: The warm milk began to coagulate into curd.

definition: an exclamation used in making oblations to the gods.
example: ಪುರೋಹಿತ ಹೋಮಕುಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಾಹಾ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಆಹುತಿ ನೀಡಿದ.
example_en: The priest offered oblation into the fire saying svāhā.

definition: first in time or order of development; primitive; original; earliest; primary.
example_en: This is the primary/original form of this culture.

definition: want of civility and culture; unrefinedness; rudeness of manners; barbarism.
example: ಅವನ ಕಾಳತನವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಯಾರೂ ಅವನ ಸಂಗಡ ಮಾತನಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Seeing his unrefined behaviour, no one spoke with him.

definition: a man who believes and trusts the God.
example_en: She is a woman devoted to and trusting in God.

definition: two pouches connected at one side of their mouth so that it can be put on the back of an animal or on one's shoulder and in both things can be filled.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಕತ್ತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಸುಬೆ ಹೊರಿಸಿ ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಹೊರಟನು.
example_en: The merchant loaded the double pouch on the donkey and set off for the market.

definition: to think carefully about, esp. in order to make a decision; contemplate; to consider.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
example_en: Consider this matter carefully and make a decision.

definition: to put down; to reduce in height, elevation, amount, price etc.
example_en: The rainwater lowered the water level.

definition: to make (something) clear.
example_en: The teacher made the lesson clear.

definition: any of a number of squirrels (esp. genus Glaucomys) with winglike folds of skin attached to the legs and body, which enable them to make long, gliding leaps; a flying squirrel.
example_en: The flying squirrel glided from tree to tree.

definition: any written record serving as proof; a document.
example_en: He submitted the document related to the property at the office.

definition: to drive (a vehicle, horse, etc.) fast.
example_en: He drove the horse fast and swiftly.

definition: the act of calming, tranquilising or soothing; tranquilisation; pacification.
example: ಅಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಮಗುವಿನ ಶಾಮನಕ್ಕೆ ತಾಯಿ ಹಾಡು ಹಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother sang a song to soothe the crying child.

definition: a garden, pleasure grove or farming estate.
example_en: Various flowers bloomed in their garden.

definition: to face in opposition; to confront.
example_en: The enemies confronted the army.

definition: a cart, wagon, carriage.
example_en: The farmer carried the grain to the market in a cart.

definition: a room or place set aside and equipped for babies and young children, esp. in the care of a nurse; a nursery.
example_en: A new nursery has been opened in the hospital.

definition: a direction or location on to one's left; the left (side).
example: ಎಡಗಡೆಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರೂ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: When I turned and looked to the left side, there was no one there.

definition: college or university education, esp. above bacheloṛs degree.
example: ಪದವಿಯ ನಂತರ ಅವನು ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: After his degree, he received higher education abroad.

definition: brightly; brilliantly; sparklingly.
example_en: The stars in the sky were sparkling brilliantly.

definition: a man whose occupation is dying; a dyer.
example: ಆ ರಂಗಾರಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಬಣ್ಣ ಹಾಕುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That dyer applies beautiful colour to the clothes.

definition: a man who sweeps or brooms; a sweeper.
example_en: Early in the morning, the sweeper swept the street.

definition: air taken into the lungs and then let out, by living beings.
example_en: After the race, his breathing was heavy.

definition: the power of enduring; ability to stand pain, distress; fortitude; endurance.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕನಿಗೆ ನೋವನ್ನು ಸಹಿಸುವ ಸಹ್ಯತೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: That soldier had the fortitude to endure pain.

definition: a replica of a burial monument or cenotaph; a facsimile-tomb.
example_en: The villagers had a facsimile-tomb built for the king.

definition: to place or keep in a liquid in order to saturate thoroughly; to soak.
example_en: Soak the clothes in water before washing them.

definition: a kind of sweet or spicy pudding cooked in steam.
example_en: They cooked steamed spicy pudding at home for the festival.

definition: a thing that is interwoven, connected closely or intricately.
example_en: The bamboo weave was tightly interwoven.

definition: any liquid substance.
example_en: Oil is a liquid substance.

definition: an arch. Tax.
example_en: The villagers used to pay the bennirke tax to the king.

definition: light; shining.
example_en: The sun's light was spreading in the east.

definition: to cause to strike with the fist; to punch.
example_en: In anger he punched the wall.

definition: projecting portion of a rampart or fortification, arranged to give a wider firing range; a bastion.
example: ಕೋಟೆಯ ಬುರಜಿನಿಂದ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುಂಡು ಹಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The soldiers fired at the enemies from the fort's bastion.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The nela sinda plant had grown on the bund of the paddy field.

definition: effort directed to an end; a work, deed done or intended to be done.
example: ಈ ಕಾಜವನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸಲು ಅವನು ಬಹಳ ಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He worked very hard to accomplish this task.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The separation of the land was done between the two.

definition: the act of spreading; diffusion.
example_en: The spreading of the disease happened very rapidly.

definition: the state of being clearly understood or realised.
example: ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಆಳವಾದ ಅರ್ಥ ಮನಗಾಣಿಕೆ ಮೂಡಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The deep meaning of the text becomes clear only when true understanding arises.

definition: for the purpose of this world.
example_en: He earned money for the purpose of this world.

definition: to stay awaiting.
example: ಅವನು ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ತಡಗೆಯ್ದು ಗೆಳೆಯನಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He stayed awaiting near the door, waiting for his friend.

definition: a resonant, imitative sound (as the bubbling or rippling sound made by flowing water).
example_en: The river water flowed making a rippling, resonant sound.

definition: the act or an instance of cleaving, breaking.
example_en: The breaking of the rock blocked the path.

definition: to emit or reflect light; to be radiant; to gleam; to glow.
example_en: The ornaments gleamed in the light.

definition: an assemblage or flock of crows.
example_en: A flock of crows sat on the tree.

definition: to endeavour - a) to strive (after) a certain end; b) to try; to make an effort to.
example_en: He constantly strove to reach his goal.

definition: any of several domesticated or wild varieties of a large, strong species (Equus caballus) of perissodactylous mammal having a long, flowing tail; a horse.
example_en: The king mounted the white horse and set out for battle.

definition: the quality of being worthy of trust or confidence; trustworthiness.
example_en: His trustworthiness is known to everyone.

definition: to sharpen by rubbing or grinding; to hone; to whet.
example_en: The blacksmith honed the knife on the stone.

definition: to rub (one's surface) with the surface of another.
example_en: The two ships rubbed against each other at the harbour.

definition: to greet or salute respectfully (esp. mentioning the names of the person saluted and of the person salutes).
example_en: He greeted the elders by name respectfully in the assembly.

definition: Samskřta, supposed to be the language of gods.
example_en: The scholars spoke in Sanskrit, the language of the gods.

definition: the nostril of a whale, on the top of its head; a blowpipe.
example: ತಿಮಿಂಗಿಲ ತನ್ನ ಊದುಗಂಡಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀರನ್ನು ಚಿಮ್ಮಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The whale sprayed water through its blowhole.

definition: a small firearm made to be held and fired with one hand; a pistol.
example_en: The policeman ran holding a pistol.

definition: (rhet.) an extravagant explicit likening of one thing to another; a hyperbolic simile.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಕವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿಶಯೋಪಮೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ನದಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಗರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet used a hyperbolic simile in his poem and compared the river to the ocean.

definition: a kind of nut-tree; .
example_en: They have planted the kalenji nut-tree in the backyard.

definition: a disc or magnetic tape on which sound is recorded.
example_en: They gave the recording of the guru's discourse to the disciples.

definition: the matted condition of hair.
example: ಅವನ ತಲೆಯ ಜೂಟಬಂಧವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: Everyone laughed seeing the matted condition of his hair.

definition: to be inflicted with a superficial wound.
example_en: The finger got a superficial wound from the knife.

definition: a white, ductile metallic element, atomic number. 13, chem. symbol Al, with good resistance to corrosion, used as a basis for many light alloys; aluminium.
example_en: Aluminium is a metal that does not rust.

definition: the undomesticated cat Felis chaus, a forest-inhabitant; wild-cat.
example_en: The wildcat hid near the bush.

definition: a heinous, abominable murder.
example_en: The police caught the culprits of the heinous murder.

definition: something that may cause harm or injury; a peril.
example_en: There is danger from animals in that forest.

definition: loss of judgement power, intelligence or wisdom; madness.
example_en: He developed madness due to the side effect of the medicine.

definition: a plant.
example_en: The root of the kannāgaru plant is used for fragrance.

definition: the office of the chief of a department.
example_en: He obtained the office of the chief of the department.

definition: a small musical instrument consisting of a lyre-shaped metal frame containing a metal tongue, played by plucking while the frame is held in the teeth, which produces twanging tones; a jew's-harp.
example_en: The folk artist was playing the jew's-harp.

definition: any forest tree.
example_en: That forest tree is hundreds of years old.

definition: one of the āgamas.
example_en: Kaladahana is one of the agamas.

definition: a kind of fig tree.
example_en: The fig tree was found on the hill.

definition: to shield from injury, danger or loss; to guard, defend; to protect.
example_en: The watchman guarded the town throughout the night.

definition: a kind of drum, a percussion instrument.
example_en: The drum resounded during the village festival.

definition: name of a town in the present Śivamogga district of Karnāṭaka.
example_en: Ikkeri is a historically famous town.

definition: a water-passage; a channel.
example_en: The farmer diverted the water in the channel.

definition: the condition of being completely naked; nakedness.
example: ಸ್ನಾನದ ಮೊದಲು ಮಗುವಿನ ನಿರುವಾಣವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ತಾಯಿ ನಕ್ಕಳು.
example_en: Seeing the child's nakedness before the bath, the mother laughed.

definition: reputation based on one's good character, behaviour, compassion, clemency, empathy, etc.
example_en: The teacher's good reputation was known to the whole village.

definition: anything one has to do or that which is done; a task; a work; a job.
example_en: Finish this task quickly.

definition: an ear-ornament made of gold inlayed with a pearl or pearls.
example: ಆಕೆ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಜಾವಳಿಯನ್ನು ಕಿವಿಗೆ ಧರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She wore the gold pearl ear-ornament for the wedding.

definition: to be able to; to become capable of.
example_en: He is able to do this work.

definition: going to a distant place.
example_en: That bird belongs to a species that goes to distant places.

definition: to prepare a horse by putting the saddle on, for riding.
example_en: The soldier saddled the horse for riding.

definition: the larges-ized tree Terminalia arjuna ( = T. Glabra) of Combretaceae family.
example_en: The matti tree grows very tall.

definition: to become incongruous; to lack harmony, agreement or compatibility.
example_en: That building has become incongruous with the surrounding houses.

definition: to produce a visual impression of an object by reflection.
example_en: The calm water was reflecting the moon.

definition: a rain-god of folklore.
example_en: The people offered worship to the rain-god Gurchi for rain.

definition: to blow and make swell; to inflate; to blow-up.
example_en: The child is inflating the balloon and playing.

definition: a single long cloth used to cover the privy parts, as by a male ascetic or poormen in warm climates; a loin cloth.
example_en: The ascetic wrapped a loin cloth around himself.

definition: a small, open container for drinking liquids; a cup.
example_en: She filled the cup with milk and drank it.

definition: a single group.
example_en: All the villagers gathered together as a single group.

definition: the quality of a wicked person; wickedness.
example_en: His wickedness gradually became known to everyone.

definition: the rear or hinder part of anything.
example_en: There is a garden at the rear part of the house.

definition: to make double; to make twice as much, as many or as large; to increase by the same quantity.
example_en: The merchant doubled the price and sold it.

definition: a troublesome or embarrassing situation.
example_en: He faced an embarrassing situation in the examination.

definition: to answer or respond, in speech or writing ; to reply.
example_en: The king replies to the messenger's words.

definition: sprung or produced from a seed (of a plant).
example: ಈ ಗಿಡ ಬೈಜಿಕ ಸಸ್ಯ ಜಾತಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: This plant belongs to a seed-grown species.

definition: to be squeezed.
example_en: Caught in the crowd, his hand got squeezed.

definition: a very huge, all-engulfing, fire.
example_en: The all-engulfing fire swallowed the entire forest.

definition: not to be served; not worthy of being served.
example: ಆ ದುಷ್ಟ ರಾಜ ಅಸೇವ್ಯನೆಂದು ಜನರು ಭಾವಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The people considered that wicked king not worthy of being served.

definition: to roar with a powerful reverberating sound, as a bull.
example: ಗಂಡು ಹೋರಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲೆದು ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆಚ್ಚಿಬೀಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The bull roared with a powerful reverberating sound in the cowshed and startled everyone.

definition: to approve; to endorse; to okay.
example_en: The officer approved that plan.

definition: to be filled with fear or terror; to be frighteed; to be scared or afraid of to fear.
example_en: The child became frightened on hearing the thunder.

definition: the hissing or buzzing sound of small flying insects (as mosquitoes).
example: ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳ ಗೊಂಯಿ ಇಡೀ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಿವಿಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The buzzing of mosquitoes kept falling on the ears the whole night.

definition: a man disinclined to work or physical exertion; a lazy, indolent man.
example_en: He is a lazy man, he cannot do any work.

definition: to be seized or filled with wonder; to feel amazement; to marvel; to wonder.
example_en: Everyone was filled with wonder seeing his work.

definition: a small piece taken out from a whole; a fragment.
example_en: A fragment fell from the tree.

definition: official records collectively.
example_en: The office records should be kept carefully.

definition: good luck; good fortune; prosperity.
example_en: By good fortune, he got a big post.

definition: the doctrine that all events are subject to fate, and happen by unavoidable necessity; fatalism.
example: ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಅದೃಷ್ಟವಾದ ಎಂದು ನಂಬಿ ಅವನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನೇ ಬಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: Believing that everything is fatalism, he gave up trying altogether.

definition: to flow in a stream.
example_en: Water flowed down in a stream from the hill.

definition: the condition of being intoxicated; drunkenness.
example_en: His state of drunkenness drew everyone's attention.

definition: water that is condensed from the aqueous vapour in the atmosphere and falls to earth in drops; rain.
example_en: This year the rain fell well.

definition: a man belonging to previous or past generation or time that has gone by.
example: ಪಿಂತಣ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಈ ಹೊಸ ಪದ್ಧತಿ ಗೊತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The people of the previous generation did not know this new custom.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example_en: The farmer woman cleaned the rice on the bamboo plate.

definition: a person mediating between a seller and a buyer for a fee or a percentage of the sale proceeds or he who negotiates as an intermediary a contract between two or more parties for a commission; a commission agent; a broker.
example_en: He is a broker for the sale of cars.

definition: the clover plant Trifolium pratense with flowers in reddish, ball-shaped heads, grown for fodder and forage; red-clover.
example_en: Farmers grew red-clover as fodder for the cattle.

definition: a programme of things to be done, esp. a list of things to be dealt with at a meeting; an agenda.
example_en: The agenda of the meeting was prepared in advance.

definition: to cause to weep; to subject another to difficulties or intolerable inconvenience.
example_en: His harsh words made her weep.

definition: a big vessel for boiling water.
example_en: Plenty of water was boiling in the big vessel.

definition: an incident that proves to be starting point for another happening or or occurrence that is of far-reaching effect.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯ ಪೀಠಿಕಾಪ್ರಕರಣ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That starting incident led to a great change.

definition: benumbed or deadened body.
example_en: His body became benumbed from the cold.

definition: a three-pronged spear; a trident.
example_en: The trident had been placed for worship in the temple.

definition: an experiencing and enjoying the things aesthetically.
example_en: The audience experienced aesthetic enjoyment at the music concert.

definition: a popular festival observed for ten days from the first to the tenth day of Āśvayuja (seventh month of lunar calendar).
example: ದಸರ ಹಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ಹತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಆಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Dasara festival is celebrated for ten days.

definition: to have a spontaneous expulsion of an embryo or a foetus before it is sufficiently developed to survive; to have a miscarriage.
example_en: She had a miscarriage in the third month.

definition: any piece of certain kinds of material, as iron, that has the property of attracting like material; a magnet.
example_en: They conducted the experiment using a magnet in the laboratory.

definition: a passage, as a tube, channel, etc. for water.
example_en: Water flowed through that channel.

definition: rhythmic movement of the body and feet ordinarily to music; dance or dancing.
example_en: The girls danced in time with the music.

definition: a man or boy whose work is tending, feeding, and currying horses; a groom.
example_en: That groom took care of the horses in the stable.

definition: a carriage drawn by a bullock or a pair of bullocks.
example_en: The farmer transported firewood in the bullock cart.

definition: a man appointed for menial work or is subject to slavery.
example: ಆ ತಂದಲು ಒಡೆಯನ ಮನೆಯ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That bonded servant was doing the master's household work.

definition: food prepared using meat.
example_en: They served meat dishes at the festival feast.

definition: a man whose occupation is to sharpen the tools, weapons, etc. by rubbing or grinding; a whetter.
example_en: The sharpener sharpened the axe and gave it back.

definition: the quality of being smooth.
example_en: The smoothness of that cloth felt pleasant to the touch.

definition: a room designed to store grain; a barn.
example_en: The farmer stored the grain in the barn.

definition: a listless, spiritless face.
example: ಸೋಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಪ್ಪೆಮೋರೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the defeat, a listless face was visible on him.

definition: a piece of light fabric worn by women, over the face; a veil.
example_en: She put a veil over her face.

definition: to become be made foul, dirty or unclean; to be polluted; to be debased.
example_en: The lake becomes polluted due to dirty water.

definition: the quality of being honest and just; truthfulness; uprightness; integrity.
example: ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ನಿಯತ್ತು ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That officer's integrity was famous throughout the town.

definition: anger that is not expressed.
example_en: She kept her unexpressed anger without saying anything.

definition: the extent, dimensions, capacity, etc. of anything, esp. as determined by a standard.
example_en: The dimensions of the house were small.

definition: the bottom part of the human foot; the sole of the foot.
example_en: A thorn pricked and the sole of his foot hurt.

definition: to submerge or keep (something) in water, vinegar or other liquids; to soak; to pickle.
example_en: Mother pickled the raw mango in salt.

definition: a small particle as seen in the beam of a sunlight that is coming into a building through a small hole.
example_en: Tiny dust particles were floating in the beam of sunlight.

definition: silencing anoher by shouting loudly.
example_en: That loud man silenced everyone by shouting.

definition: owned by private persons (as diff. from owned by government, public).
example_en: This is a privately owned institution, not a government one.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A nelalu tree stood by the side of the road.

definition: a man not having consciousness; a man in unconscious stage.
example_en: Injured in the accident, he was unconscious.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The blow of his hand struck the chest.

definition: a woman whose profession is to act on a stage; an actress.
example: ಆ ಅಭಿನೇತ್ರಿ ರಂಗಮಂದಿರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಅಭಿನಯ ನೀಡಿದಳು.
example_en: That actress gave an excellent performance in the theatre.

definition: one's native country.
example_en: He returned again to his native country.

definition: to wear (an ornament, dress, etc.).
example_en: She wears a gold necklace.

definition: sadness; grief; sorrow; distress.
example_en: Grief was common in her life of poverty.

definition: to come out; to appear to the senses; to show itself; to manifest; to come into existence.
example_en: The moon appeared from among the clouds.

definition: a government department or its office that deals with civil matters.
example_en: That file was sent to the civil administration office.

definition: the 'Khurasān' province, situated in the north east of Iran.
example_en: The cloth that came from the Khurasan province was very famous.

definition: an unrefined, uncultured fellow.
example_en: That uncultured fellow speaks rudely with everyone.

definition: afflicted; distressed; passing through bad or difficult times; dejected.
example: ಮಗನ ಅಪಘಾತದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳು ಅಭ್ಯಾಕುಲಳಾದಳು.
example_en: She became distressed on hearing the news of her son's accident.

definition: to take out the sails of a vessel.
example_en: As soon as they reached the harbour, the sailors took out the sails.
